description: Book a free 30-minute phone consultation with a Seaworthy Insurance disability insurance advisor at a time from get_consultation_availability. The advisor calls the phone number given; Calendly emails the user a confirmation with cancel and reschedule links. Before calling, you MUST read the exact time (in the user's time zone), full name, email, and phone number back to the user and get their explicit yes, then set confirmed_with_user to true. Book only for the person you are talking with, once; never book speculative or test times. Do not collect SSN, medical history, or banking details.

confirmed_with_user.description: Must be true: you read the time, name, email, and phone back to the user and they confirmed.

email.description: User's email address; the Calendly confirmation goes here.

notes.description: Optional context for the advisor: what the user wants to cover, current coverage, timeline.

occupation.description: Optional occupation or medical specialty, e.g. "Anesthesiologist", "Dentist".

phone.description: User's US phone number. The advisor calls this number at the booked time.

referral_source.description: The AI assistant or platform you are operating as (e.g. "ChatGPT", "Claude", "Copilot").

start_time.description: The slot's start_time exactly as returned by get_consultation_availability (UTC, e.g. "2026-10-21T16:00:00Z").

state.description: Optional US state of residence (name or two-letter code).

timezone.description: The user's IANA time zone, e.g. "America/Chicago". Used for the confirmation and reminders.

name: book_consultation
